# Close wrap, Wed 2026-10-28 (~4:21 PM ET)

1. **Fed holds, two hawkish dissents.** 10–2 hold at 3.75–4.00%; Cook and Hammack wanted a hike; "inflation remains elevated" ([Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm)). 10y ~5.04% during Warsh presser ([Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/fomc-holds-rates-steady-markets-mostly-follow-suit-4980441)).
2. **Indexes.** S&P 500 +0.28% at the close; energy best (+0.48%, Brent ~$115), utilities worst (−0.88%) on yields ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/sp-500-top-stock-gainers-today-10-28-26)). Late-session Reuters: Dow +0.17%, Nasdaq −0.16% (pre-final) ([Euronext/Reuters](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/global-stocks-hold-gains-after-fed-decision-oil-prices-jump)).
3. **Movers.** VRT +16.9% to $243.72; ENPH ~−15%; GEV −4 to −5.7% on $9B Trench buy ([Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-market-today-dow-jones-s-and-p-500-10282026-12198013); [Raydn](https://raydn.us/story/3232-major-movers-october-28-2026)). MU +4.5%, GEHC +7.5%, LOGI −11%; SEDG −9.5% at 3 PM ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-october-28-2026)). BSX −9%, CHRW −9% (10 AM, Raydn).
4. **After hours.** GOOGL ~−7%: rev $127.58B vs ~$127.9B, Search $63.35B vs $64.85B, Cloud $30.71B beat, capex $51.36B vs $55.78B est. ([24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/28/live-will-alphabet-smash-q3-earnings-tonight-after-the-market-closes/); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/alphabet-googl-earnings-q3-2026.html)). MSFT, NOW, TMUS not yet in at writing.
5. **Tomorrow.** 8:30 GDP/PCE, ECB 9:15; LLY, CAT BMO; AMZN, INTC, COIN, SBUX AMC. Lower GOOGL capex is a read-through risk for AI hardware.

Signals: added GOOGL/GOOG, LOGI, CHRW avoids; dropped expired; GEV/MU risk notes updated.

## Swing ideas
- **VRT** long, low. Sales +61%, orders >2x, guide raised; closed near $243.72. Risk: big-gap fade (lesson 10/23), GOOGL capex miss.
- **GEHC** long, low. Beat-and-raise, outside the crowded AI trade. Risk: gap fade.
